T: New rules. Same rules. Not after midnight.
D: The gremlins break loose inside a high-tech Manhattan skyscraper.
P: Serve the snacks before midnight, still.
S: Pan fried pork and cabbage dumplings with ginger, steamed until tender

Pork and cabbage potstickers folded, fried until the bottoms brown, steamed under a lid, with a soy and black vinegar dip. Mix 400g pork mince with 2 cups shredded wombok, salted and squeezed, and 1 tbsp grated ginger. Fill 30 gyoza wrappers and pleat. Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes. Dip in soy and Chinkiang vinegar.
Corn chips baked with black beans, cheddar and jalapeños

Corn chips layered with black beans, cheddar and jalapeño, baked at 200C for 8 minutes (the oven, not the microwave), salsa and sour cream. Layer a 300g bag of corn chips with a drained tin of black beans, 200g grated cheddar and sliced jalapeños. Bake in the oven at 200C for 8 minutes, not the microwave. Top with diced tomato and 150g sour cream.
the lobby deli in the smart building

Corned beef, sauerkraut and melted Swiss cheese on rye with Russian dressing, griddled in butter until crisp and cut into halves. Mix 4 tbsp mayonnaise, 2 tbsp tomato sauce, 1 tbsp chopped pickles and a dash of hot sauce for the dressing. Butter one side of 8 slices of rye. On the unbuttered side of 4, layer dressing, 2 slices Swiss cheese, 100g sliced corned beef and 3 tbsp drained sauerkraut, then top with the rest. Cook in a pan over medium heat with a weight on top for 4 minutes a side until crisp and melted.
M: Steamed pastrami piled on rye with spicy mustard, potato salad on the side
Pastrami steamed 10 minutes until soft and piled high on rye spread with spicy mustard, a whole dill pickle and a creamy potato salad with celery and dill on the side.
the boss's very fancy top floor

Pounded beef fillet seared and finished in a pan sauce of mushrooms, brandy, mustard, Worcestershire and cream, with crisp potato rösti and green beans. Grate 800g potatoes, squeeze dry, mix with salt and fry as 4 rösti in butter for 6 minutes a side. Pound 4 x 180g beef fillet steaks to 1.5cm and sear in a hot pan for 2 minutes a side, then rest. Add 20g butter, 1 diced shallot and 150g sliced mushrooms and cook 3 minutes. Add 50ml brandy, then 1 tbsp Dijon, 1 tbsp Worcestershire and 150ml cream and bubble 2 minutes. Serve the steaks with sauce, rösti and buttered beans.
W: Red, white and green almond sponge layers stacked with apricot jam
New York Italian bakery layers of almond sponge in three colours with jam and a chocolate top.
K: Muddled lychee, lime and mint over crushed ice with lychee syrup

Lychees muddled with lime and mint, topped with ginger beer and soda over crushed ice, a lychee on each skewer. Keep the glasses well away from the mogwai. Drain a 565g tin of lychees, keeping 100ml syrup. Muddle 12 lychees with the juice of 3 limes and a handful of mint in a jug. Add the reserved syrup, fill with crushed ice and top with 500ml ginger beer and 300ml soda water. Stir gently, pour into glasses and garnish each with a lychee on a skewer and a mint sprig.

steps.text: Mix the pork, wombok and ginger.
Fill the gyoza wrappers and pleat.
Fry until browned, add water and steam under a lid for 4 minutes.
Mix the soy and Chinkiang vinegar for dipping.
Layer the corn chips with the beans, cheddar and jalapeños.
Bake in the oven at 200C for 8 minutes, not the microwave.
Top with diced tomato and sour cream.
Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and toss with the mayo, celery and dill.
Steam the pastrami for 10 minutes until soft.
Pile high on the rye spread with spicy mustard.
Serve each sandwich with a whole dill pickle.
Beat the almond meal, butter, sugar and eggs, then fold in the flour.
Divide in three, leaving one plain and colouring the others red and green.
Spread each thin in a lined tin and bake at 180C for 12 minutes each, in batches.
Stack the layers with apricot jam.
Top with melted chocolate and chill to set.
Cut into small bars.
